title: VS Code Variables
description: VS Code group: editor provisioning parameters. Variable names are camelCase and prefixed with the group token 'vscode'.

vscodeOperations.description: Ordered, non-empty list of VS Code operations to run. The currently supported operation is install; supply it at ansible-playbook runtime with -e.

vscodeExtensions.description: VS Code extension IDs the vscode role installs (e.g. redhat.vscode-yaml). An empty list installs none.
